init.title: Vehicle status updates
init.description: Home Assistant keeps checking Toyota's cloud for available status without waking the vehicle. Cloud data may remain unchanged until the vehicle contacts Toyota. Choose how often Home Assistant should also wake the vehicle to request fresh status. Select Cloud updates only to disable automatic wakes. Refresh Status and remote commands remain available.
